court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: JMFC, Vasai, being RCC No. 2228 of 2021
case_name: Nehul Bhuvnesh Pandya And Ors vs Surbhi Nehul Pandya And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Nehul Bhuvnesh Pandya, Mr. Bhuvnesh Pandya, Smt. Dipti Bhuvnesh Pandya, Miss Urvi Bhuvnesh Pandya (husband, in-laws, sister-in-law)
parties.respondent_defendant: Surbhi Nehul Pandya, Sr. Inspector of Police, State of Maharashtra (wife, police, state)

facts_of_case: Petitioners are husband and in-laws who allegedly ill-treated and harassed respondent wife. Respondent lodged FIR alleging offences under IPC sections 498-A, 504, 506, 323 r/w 34. Parties amicably settled dispute. Quashing of FIR sought.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes amicably and seek quashing of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The parties have amicably settled their dispute. It appears that the Respondent No.1 had also initiated Domestic Violence proceeding against the Petitioners, which was withdrawn by her, pursuant to the Consent Terms entered into between the parties.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to abide by terms and conditions stipulated in a joint affidavit.
legal_principles.held: The parties have agreed to abide by the terms and conditions as stipulated therein. Today, pursuant to one of the terms of the Consent Terms, the Petitioner No.1 has handed over a Demand Draft to the Respondent No.1.

outcome.final_order: FIR quashed as parties have amicably settled their dispute.

use_for_drafting: quashing FIR in Hindu Marriage Act case
seeking final disposal of writ petition
